# Get groups group_portal = env.ref('base.group_portal') group_internal = env.ref('base.group_user') group_public = env.ref('base.group_public') group_participant = env.ref('ak_exams.group_nutricia_exams_participants')

for user in records: try: # Skip admin user if user.id == env.ref('base.user_admin').id: skipped_count += 1 continue
